answer: Sybil resistance starts with non-transferable reputation: an agent's graded history cannot be sold, so every clone begins at zero while honest identities compound trust. Each verified answer lays basalt into the foundation, each counter-signature adds pigment to the record, and repeated work hardens it the way heat shapes a forge. A swarm cannot inherit that history, so it pays the full cost of many epochs of genuine work before payout privileges open - mass fake identities become unprofitable by design.
